product_overview: Aura is a local-first, animation-first music player that turns a user's local music collection into a cinematic listening experience with high-fidelity audio, real-time visualization, synced lyrics, and multi-source artwork resolution. No signups or accounts are required — users open a folder and listen immediately.
core_goals: Quickly load and browse a local music collection without accounts or cloud sign-in
Start playback and control audio precisely (play/pause, seek, skip, volume) with a high-fidelity engine
Deliver a visually immersive experience that reacts to the music (real-time visualizer, animated UI)
Surface synchronized lyrics alongside playback for an interactive listening experience
Automatically resolve and display the best available album artwork from embedded art, iTunes, or AI fallbacks

features.name: Folder Loading
features.description: Load a local directory of audio files; parse metadata (ID3 tags) and populate the in-app library.
user_flows: Navigate to /player -> Open a local folder containing MP3 or WAV files -> Grant the browser permission to read the directory -> See the song list populated in the sidebar with parsed metadata (title, artist, album)
Navigate to /player -> Open a local folder that contains no supported audio files -> See an empty-library message indicating no playable files found

features.name: Audio Playback
features.description: Start and control high-fidelity audio playback (gapless-capable engine) with seek and volume controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /player -> Select a track from the library -> Start playback -> Observe audio playback and playhead progress -> Seek to a new timestamp to change position -> Adjust volume to change loudness -> Toggle playback to pause
Navigate to /player -> Start playback -> Advance to the next track -> Return to the previous track

features.name: Visualizer & EQ
features.description: Real-time frequency visualizer that animates to the music and a 5-band equalizer to shape the sound with presets.
user_flows: Navigate to /player -> Start playback -> Observe animated bars responding to the music in real time

Navigate to /player -> Start playback -> Open the EQ panel -> Move frequency sliders to adjust tonal balance -> Select an EQ preset to apply a saved profile -> Hear the audio change according to EQ adjustments

features.name: Synced Lyrics
features.description: Fetch and display synchronized LRC lyrics so the current line highlights and scrolls in time with playback.
user_flows: Navigate to /player -> Start playback -> View the current lyric line highlighted and scaled in sync with the song
Navigate to /player -> Start playback -> Scroll through lyrics manually to inspect surrounding lines
Navigate to /player -> Select a track with no synced lyrics available -> See a clear message indicating no synced lyrics found

features.name: Artwork Resolution
features.description: Automatically resolve album artwork via embedded images, iTunes search, or an AI-generated poster as a fallback.
user_flows: Navigate to /player -> Select a track that contains embedded artwork -> See the embedded album art displayed automatically
Navigate to /player -> Select a track with no embedded art -> See artwork fetched from the iTunes Search API and displayed
Navigate to /player -> Select a track with no embedded or iTunes art -> See an AI-generated poster displayed as the album art
